tau_a.locator: Souihel & Cessac 2021, Eq6-9 PDF pp7-8, Table1 PDF p43
tau_a.uncertainty: Literature starting value, not a macaque BC measurement or fitted value

scale.rationale: r is a normalized sigmoid release in [0,1], so A_ss<=.75 and gain>=1/(1+.75^6)=.8489119. Choosing .75 below 5^(-1/6) keeps the constant-input r_eff(r) monotone; it cannot invert the steady ON/OFF ordering. Chosen before testing, without data fitting.
scale.uncertainty: Uncalibrated conservative engineering strength; not converted from author h_B

source.shape_transfer: The exponent6 and100ms are borrowed model choices, not universal physiological laws
source.zero_point_choice: Eq9 prints G(A<=0)=0, whereas Fig3/Eq10 use G(0)=1. This implementation uses continuous G(0)=1 on the nonnegative domain.

initialization: A0=scale*r0 is a conditional seed only; solve/prepare the actual coupled background before claiming convergence
